In the summer of 2011, Sam is an aimless 33-year-old in Silver Lake, Los Angeles, more interested in conspiracy theories than paying his overdue rent.
Six months after the events of the second film, both the government and the general public have become aware of the existence of the Vampires and Lycans.

Years after his defeat by George "Iceman" Chambers, Yuri Boyka, now a prison janitor, hears about the Prison Spetz Competition (PSC), an inter-prison fighting tournament offering a chance at early release.
Dan Trunkman decides to leave Dynamic Systems and start his own business in the metal swarf-selling field after a pay dispute with his boss, Charlene "Chuck" Portnoy.
Julia Banks is questioned by police after the body of her abusive ex-boyfriend Michael Vargas is found in her home.

In Fresno, California in 2013, high school student Laura Barns dies by suicide via gunshot after an anonymous user uploads a video of her passing out and defecating at an unsupervised party, making it go viral.
Matias takes home a MacBook Pro left at a cyber café.
Kit, a failed artist, moves back in with her parents and takes a temp job at a PR agency.
A man is in a hospital bed (John) distressed from dreaming intruders in his house brutally assault him, then watching as the leader shoots his wife and child dead.
Martin Harris and his wife Liz arrive in Berlin for a biotechnology summit.
After a Paris operation fails on her watch, Central Intelligence Agency interrogation officer Alice Racine works undercover at a community centre in London.
To escape a stalker, Sawyer Valentini moves away from her Boston home.

A botched switching operation by yard hostlers Dewey and Gilleece at an Allegheny and West Virginia Railroad (AWVR) yard in northern Pennsylvania results in a freight train pulled by locomotive 777 (Triple 7) heading south at full throttle, hauling 39 cars.
An American former Delta Force operator, Steven Younger, makes a videotape.
The film begins with a man (mentioned in the credits as the "Thief") who seems to be harvesting a type of larva for the peculiar effects it has on the human mind when ingested.
In 1986, little Adelaide Thomas wanders away from her parents at the Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk and enters a funhouse.
The film is presented as an anthology of five short horror films, built into a frame narrative which acts as its own sixth short horror film.

Rusty Griswold is now a pilot for the low budget regional airline Econo-Air, living in suburban Chicago and in a stale relationship with his wife Debbie and their two sons, shy and awkward 14-year-old James, and naughty and sadistic 12-year-old Kevin, who constantly bullies and torments James.
Florist Reed Bennett wakes up and proposes to his girlfriend Morley Clarkson, who accepts.

Paul, a projectionist in a Detroit theater, is reading about the 16th-century disappearance of the Roanoke Colony when the lights suddenly go out.
Michael Woods is an American, recently out of jail, and breaches his parole conditions by flying to Johannesburg, where his estranged wife Angie works in the U.S.

In Miami, art critic Morf Vandewalt attends an art exhibition alongside his friend Josephina, who works for Rhodora Haze, owner of the Haze Gallery and formerly a member of the punk rock band Velvet Buzzsaw.
While exploring space for new habitable worlds, a probe belonging to the bio-engineering corporation Life Foundation discovers a comet covered in symbiotic lifeforms.

Nine years after the events of the series finale, former teenage sleuth Veronica Mars has left Neptune, California, and moved to New York City, where she is in a relationship with Stosh "Piz" Piznarski and has a job offer from the prestigious law firm Truman-Mann and Associates.
Best friends Lilly and Gerri spend their last summer in New York together.
A futuristic resort, Vice, offers visitors the opportunity to live out all their fantasies, no matter how violent or deviant, on sophisticated androids (referred to as "artificials").
Vice is narrated by Kurt, a fictitious veteran of the Afghan and Iraq wars.
In 1860s London, medical student Victor Frankenstein attends a circus.

Abdul Karim, a young prison clerk from a Muslim, Urdu-speaking family in Agra, British India, is instructed to travel to Britain for Queen Victoria's Golden Jubilee in 1888 to present her with a mohur, a gold coin that has been minted as a token of appreciation from British-ruled India.
Lovers Mickey and Jules clumsily rob a gas station and take off, celebrating their last score before moving to Florida.

In the 2000s, Wadjda, a spirited 10-year-old living in Riyadh, dreams of owning a green bicycle that she passes at a store every day on her way to school.
Emma (Rachel Bilson) and Will (Tom Sturridge) were childhood best friends; they lost touch a long time ago—as far as she knows.
Howard Wakefield, an attorney in New York City, is unhappy in his marriage of fifteen years to Diana, an art curator and former dancer.
Meghan Miles, a newscaster for local Los Angeles TV affiliate KZLA6, is rejected for an anchor position with a network news program in favor of news reporter Wendy Chang.

In 2008, seven years after former corporate raider Gordon Gekko was released from prison after serving time for insider trading and securities fraud, Gekko is promoting his new book Is Greed Good?, warning about a possible 2008 financial crisis.
George and Linda Gergenblatt are an urban married couple who purchase a micro-loft in New York after much hesitation.
In 2005, David Packouz, a massage therapist living in Miami, Florida with his girlfriend Iz, spends his life savings on an unsuccessful venture to sell bedsheets to retirement homes.
A bay Irish Hunter is born in Devon, England in 1912.

In the summer of 2009, four-star General Glen McMahon, having won renown for his effective leadership in Iraq, is sent to Afghanistan to prepare a strategic assessment so the government can end the ongoing war.
Pharmaceutical salesman Tony Jordan and his wife, realtor Elizabeth Jordan, appear outwardly successful; they have a large house, plenty of money, and a beautiful daughter named Danielle.

column5: Two years after the Battle of San Francisco, an U.S.
Draenor, homeworld to the orcs, is being torn apart by a force known as fel magic.

About eight years after a zombie apocalypse, R, a zombie who cannot recall his name but believes it began with an "R", spends his days wandering around an airport which is now filled with his fellow undead, including M, who is his best friend.
A melancholic U.S.
Circus owner Charlie O'Brien encounters an elderly man named Jacob Jankowski, who is separated from his nursing home group.
Tyler Williams is a popular high school senior on the wrestling team.
In Denver, low-level marijuana dealer David Clark is robbed of his money and stash, some of which he owes to his supplier and college acquaintance Brad Gurdlinger.
In 1979, following the death of their son Bobby in a car crash, Anne and Paul Sacchetti have decided to move to a new home in rural New England.
The Parkers are a somewhat reclusive religious family living in the Catskill Mountains who are about to undergo a period of ritual fasting.
Cole Carter, a San Fernando Valley native, former track star, college dropout, and struggling 23-year-old DJ in the electronic dance music (EDM) scene, dreams of becoming a major record producer.
Seven months after the death of his wife Katherine, Benjamin Mee's 14-year-old son Dylan is expelled from school.

column2: We Need to Talk About Kevin
column5: Armenian mother Eva Khatchadourian, once a successful travel writer, lives alone in a rundown house and works in a travel agency near a prison, where she visits her son, Kevin, who has been convicted of mass-murdering students at his high school.
A World War II Curtiss P-40 warplane piloted by a doll-like figure is hit by enemy fire and forced to ditch.
Alice Klieg, a mentally ill single woman living on disability benefits and fan of Oprah Winfrey, wins the California Stack Sweepstakes lottery jackpot of $86 million.
Four gunmen emerge from a building in gas masks after a robbery and leave on motorbikes.
Ever since the death of their teenage daughter Emily, Doug and Lois Riley have been drifting apart.
In Boston, Ally Darling is a 30-something woman, struggling to make better life decisions.
Six-year-old Maisie lives in a New York apartment with her parents, Susanna, a singer in a rock band, and Beale, an international art dealer.
Ali Davis is a successful sports agent in Atlanta, who feels boxed out by her male colleagues.
Advertised as "The Health Film That Health Organizations Don't Want You To See", the film follows Kip Andersen as he interviews physicians and other individuals on diet and health topics.

column2: What to Expect When You're Expecting
column5: Prologue Set in Atlanta, the film opens with TV fitness trainer Jules Baxter and her dance partner Evan Webber performing on the TV show Celebrity Dance Factor.
An unnamed getaway driver picks up a BMW 3 Series (E46) for a bank robbery.
Noah Ashby is in love with beautiful Avery Martin after meeting her at a 2014 Halloween party, but she regards him as a friend.
Successful and single 29-year-old Beth, an art curator at the Guggenheim, is at a point in her life where love seems like a luxury she can't afford.
Bob Ladouceur, the coach of the De La Salle Spartans, watches his team win the championship of their undefeated 2003 season.
Architect-turned-agoraphobe Bernadette Fox is settled down with her husband Elgin "Elgie" Branch and their 15-year-old daughter Balakrishna "Bee" in a dilapidated former schoolhouse in Seattle.
Middle-aged couple Josh and Cornelia Srebnick are filmmakers living in a shaky marriage in New York City.
Andrew Neiman, a 19-year-old jazz drummer, attends the prestigious Shaffer Conservatory in New York City.
In 2003 New York City, Kim Baker is a struggling television journalist covering low-profile stories.
In 1988, 17-year-old Katrina "Kat" Connors' beautiful but mercurial mother, Eve, disappears without a trace.
In 1984, Rick Wershe is a struggling single father living in Detroit during the height of the crack epidemic and the war on drugs.
U.S.
Stanford student Stephanie Fleming invites her partner Laird Mayhew over to "Netflix and chill".
In Chicago, Harry Rawlings and his criminal gang's getaway van is blown up during a police standoff after stealing $2 million from crime boss Jamal Manning.
In June 1995, despite a lack of hiking experience, Cheryl Strayed leaves Minneapolis to hike, by herself, of the Pacific Crest Trail.
Nick Wild is a recovering gambling addict who takes odd jobs in Las Vegas as a "chaperone" (his version of a bodyguard) to support his addiction.
In 1960, Jeannette and Jerry Brinson have recently moved to Great Falls, Montana, with their teenage son Joe.

Small-town New Providence, New Jersey, attorney Mike Flaherty moonlights as a wrestling coach and struggles to keep his practice solvent, while shielding his wife Jackie and their two young girls, Abby and Stella, from the extent of the problem.
Sarah Winchester is the widow of famed gun manufacturer William Wirt Winchester.
During the winter on the Wind River Indian Reservation, U.S.
Abby decides to celebrate her friend Rebecca's 50th birthday with a weekend getaway over her protests that she wants a low-key celebration.
In the rural Ozarks of Missouri, seventeen-year-old Ree Dolly looks after her mentally ill mother, Connie, twelve-year-old brother Sonny, and six-year-old sister Ashlee.
In 1895, a young immigrant couple is refused entry into Manhattan because they have consumption (tuberculosis).
Aidan Bloom is a 35-year-old father of two struggling to be an actor in Los Angeles while his wife, Sarah, works a tedious data entry job.
Clare Shannon, a seventeen-year-old high school outcast, is haunted by the memory of her mother's suicide that she witnessed as a young child.

In a series of flashbacks, Maria Altmann recalls the Anschluss, the arrival of Nazi forces in Vienna, the persecution of the Jewish community, and the looting and pillaging by the Nazis of Jewish families.
August "Auggie" Pullman is a 10-year-old boy living in Brooklyn with his parents, Isabel and Nate, older sister Olivia "Via", and their dog, Daisy.
Mickey Rubin, a Coney Island lifeguard who aspires to be a playwright like Eugene O'Neill, narrates through the fourth wall.
Former United Nations investigator Gerald "Gerry" Lane, his wife, Karin, and their two daughters, Rachel and Connie, are caught in traffic in downtown Philadelphia when a zombie outbreak hits.
A young woman named Iris struggles to finance her brother Raleigh's leukemia treatment.
Will is a New Orleans–based bartender who works at a run-down cockroach-infested bar.
In Brazil, a satellite that had fallen out of orbit crashes on NSA Agent Augustus Gibbons who is attempting to recruit footballer Neymar for the Triple-X (xXx) program, seemingly killing them both.
It is the fall of 2000.

Colleen Collette and Colleen McKenzie are two 15-year-old girls who spend their days studying yoga with their guru, Yogi Bayer, and working an after-school job at a Manitoba convenience store called Eh-2-Zed.
A couple, Talia and Erik Harson, have sex.
Kate Parker is a classical pianist who is diagnosed with ALS.
In 2002 in the fictional town of Ridgefield, California, awkward teenager Marni Olsen is bullied by popular girl JJ.
Joe is a traumatized hired gun who specializes in rescuing trafficked girls, using brutal methods against their captors.

column2: You Will Meet a Tall Dark Stranger
column5: Alfie and Helena divorce.
Mavis Gary is a 37-year-old divorced, alcoholic ghost writer of a series of young adult novels, on deadline with her editor to finish the last book of the soon-to-be-canceled series.
Thadeous and Fabious are sons of King Tallious in the Kingdom of Mourne.
Jack is struggling emotionally a year after the death of his brother.
Ann Burden, the seemingly sole survivor of a recent nuclear apocalypse, lives an agrarian life on her family's valley farmstead with her dog.
Maya is a CIA analyst tasked with finding the al-Qaeda leader Osama bin Laden.
While transporting toxic chemicals, a pair of truckers strike a deer and lose one of their canisters.

Ten years after the zombie outbreak, Tallahassee, Columbus, Wichita and Little Rock encounter new strains of zombies: "Homers" (slow and dumb), "Hawkings" (partial intelligence), and "Ninjas" (silent and deadly).
In Boston, zookeeper Griffin Keyes proposes to his girlfriend Stephanie, but is turned down.

Agent Valentina Valencia of Interpol's fashion division, a former swimsuit model, examines the expressions of recently-assassinated pop singers' last images, believing they match Derek Zoolander's signature look, "Blue Steel".
